Then, the user is healed for 5% of max HP, granted 3 Charges, and Sleep for 100TU, even if they have already slept. A random enemy is also granted Sleep for 200TU, even if they have already slept. The next time the user is awake at the end of a turn, they will be healed for 5% of max HP, and have their current TU reduced by 100. Usable only if the user has no Charges stored.
localization.selected:

(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Cult of Madness
localization.description:
Enemies damaged by an attack from this unit are Mega Poisoned for 200TU. Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison.

If this unit is on 1HP at the end of a turn, it is healed for 5% max HP and Purified (negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed) at the end of the turn.

This unit gains 3 charges. Triggered both at the very start of the battle if this unit is on the battlefield, and when this unit enters the battlefield from reinforcements.

If this unit would be defeated while it has any charges, this unit will consume 1 charge to survive with 1HP remaining instead. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store up to 3 charges.

localization.name: The Great One
localization.description:
Whenever an enemy enters the battlefield from reinforcements, this unit has a 100% chance to immediately have its TU reduced to 0, be Purified, and be granted Sleep Immunity until the end of the turn.

The first time this unit is damaged by an attack while this unit has no Charges, and is below 10% of max HP, it will enter Warped Reality for 200TU. While in Warped Reality, this unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield, cannot be defeated by damage, has 90% damage reduction from attacks and is a Guardian.

Whenever this unit gets the turn in Warped Reality, it will lose the turn and Mega Poison all non-sleeping enemies for 200TU. Then if there is more than 1 enemy on the battlefield and no enemy is Hypnotized, this unit will hypnotize 1 random enemy on the battlefield. This unit cannot be Hypnotized while in Warped Reality. When Warped Reality ends, this unit will be sacrificed.

While this unit is a Guardian, for any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies, this unit has a 100% chance to redirect 1 hit to itself instead. This unit will not redirect skills that don't deal damage. A Hypnotized enemy will use its next turn to grant the turn to and Purify the hypnotizer (the turn will be lost as if it were sleeping), and then the hypnosis will end. Hypnosis is not a status effect and cannot be removed by Purify skills, but will be canceled if the hypnotizer is defeated or leaves the battlefield.

Then if 4 allies were already on the battlefield, the user sends themself to the back of allied reinforcements.

localization.name: Great Thief
localization.description:
This unit enters battle with Stealth, a Stealth Shield, and will Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP. Endure effects cannot stack. When this unit enters the battlefield from allied reinforcements, it grants all non-sleeping enemies the Super Poison status effect.

At the end of each of this unit's turns, if this unit is not-sleeping, it will be granted Stealth and a Stealth Shield.

Super Poison will overwrite other status effects on those enemies. Super Poison deals 4 times the damage of normal poison, and cannot be overwritten by normal poison. Stealth will overwrite other Status effects on this unit. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth.

localization.name: Art of Invisibility
localization.description:
Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will be granted Stealth, and will immediately get the turn by having its TU reduced to 0.

When this unit enters the battlefield from allied reinforcements, it grants an ally with the lowest TU and a Stealth Strike type skill:

- Stealth
- a Stealth Shield
- the next turn by reducing their current TU to 0.

Damage from this attack does not wake up sleeping enemies. All enemies hit by this attack will become Weakened, this will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on those units.

Adds a Shadow Double to the next in line of allied reinforcements if a Shadow Double is not next in line in allied reinforcements. Then if 4 allies were already on the battlefield, the user exchanges themselves with the next unit in allied reinforcements. Usable if this unit's active skill Assassinate is locked.

300% damage to 1 enemy, plus 100% for each time this skill has already been used while on the battlefield (max of 600% total damage). If not burning, the user will be granted Sleep Thorns. This attack ignores enemy damage reduction effects and any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated.

When a unit with Sleep Thorns is dealt damage by an attack, that unit's Sleep Thorns will be consumed to immediately grant the Cursed Sleep status effect for 200TU to the attacker. Burn or attacks that grant Burn will remove Sleep Thorns and prevent Cursed Sleep from applying. Cursed Sleep will overwrite status effects other than Burn, cannot be overwritten by Poison, can be applied repeatedly to units that have already slept while on the battlefield, and will not end from damage caused by Dream Hunter type active skills.
localization.selected: Up to 600% damage and grants Sleep Thorns

localization.name: One Thousand Cuts
localization.description: 300% damage to 2 enemies. 500% damage instead to targets that do not have the Burn status effect. This attack ignores damage reduction effects, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect. Unlocked each time the user damages an enemy with another attack. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.
localization.selected: Up to 500% damage, ignores damage reduction

localization.name: Healing Leaves
localization.description:
Removes Poison (including Lethal Poison) and Sleep from all allies on the battlefield. For each status effect removed in this way, Allies steal up to 1 Spirit from the enemy team, and a random enemy is granted Cursed Sleep for 200TU.

Then all allies on the battlefield:
- Heal for 1% of the user's attack.
- Gain Stealth, a Stealth Shield, Poison Ward and Sleep Ward.
- Are granted Stun Resist Lv5 for 50TU (Reduce the amount of any stun effects against the unit by 50TU).

This skill becomes locked for 100TU after use. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack. Stealth will overwrite other Status effects on affected units. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth.
localization.selected: Heals, Grants Stealth, Wards, Stun Resist

localization.name: Autumn's Blade
localization.description:

This effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, and cannot be redirected by Guardians.

500% damage to 1 enemy, and the user is granted a Power Charge. 600% damage instead if the target is poisoned. This attack cannot be redirected by Guardians. This attack ignores the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.

Unlocked each time the user damages an enemy with another attack. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield. Power Charges cannot stack and will be removed when the user leaves the battlefield.

localization.description: 800% damage to 2 enemies, and the user will Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP. Endure effects cannot stack. Minus 100% damage for each enemy on the battlefield that is not poisoned (max of -400% if 4 enemies are not poisoned). If this attack damages a target, the user's Power Charge is consumed. localization.name: Peach Legend
localization.description:
This unit cannot be burned, or be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

This unit has 30% damage reduction from attacks. While there is a poisoned enemy on the battlefield, this unit has 60% damage reduction instead.

The first time this unit is damaged by an attack while it does not have its Active Skills disabled, this unit will have its TU reduced to 0.

This unit's attacks remove burn status effects (including Mega Healing Burn) from hit targets.

localization.name: Imposter Drive
localization.description:
Whenever an imposter on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, a random ally will have their current TU reduced by 25TU.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will heal for 1% of its max HP and be Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).

localization.name: Stun Immunity
localization.description: This unit is not affected by stun effects.

localization.name: Infectious Burn
localization.description:
300% damage to 1 enemy, plus 100% for each turn the user has gotten and survived until after the end of the turn on the battlefield (max of 600% total damage). That enemy will also be granted the Burn status effect, and become infected with it. This attack ignores damage reduction effects, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

After the end of each turn, this infection will trigger to apply Burn to a random non-burning unit on the infected unit's team. Infection ends after 3 triggers (even if they find no valid target) or once the infected enemy is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Infection is not a status effect and cannot be prevented or purified, but the status effect spread by the infection may be. A unit cannot get a new infection until their existing one ends.

Burn will overwrite other status effects. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with burn will also become burned.
localization.selected: 300%+ damage, grants Burn & Infection

localization.selected:

Allies gain 2 Spirit for each ally on the battlefield. All allies on the battlefield heal for 1% of max HP, gain the Burn status effect, and are Enraged.

Then, immediately give all other burning allies the next turns by reducing their current TU. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by any affected units until after they have had the turn.

Usable if the user has defeated 1+ units with attacks while on the battlefield. Usable once per battle.

Burn will overwrite other status effects. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with burn will also become burned. An Enraged unit's attack is increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn. Enrage will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on the user.
localization.selected:
Gain Spirit, Burn, and Enrage
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Hot Flare
localization.description:
Targets all enemies. All burning targets are weakened and granted a Rage ward. All non-burning targets are stunned for 50TU.

Usable if at least 1 enemy on the battlefield is not burning. This skill becomes locked for 100TU after use.

Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. These effects will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on affected units. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects. Rage Wards will prevent a unit from becoming Enraged once, then be removed. Rage Wards cannot stack.
localization.selected:
May Weaken enemies or grant them Burn
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Red Dragon Heat
localization.description:
300% damage to 2 random enemies. 600% damage instead to targets that are burning. This attack cannot be redirected by Guardians, and will ignore any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the targets from being defeated, enemy damage reduction effects, the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills. This attack can hit targets that have the Stealth Status Effect or a passive effect that ignores multiple target attacks.

Unlocked each time the user damages an enemy with another attack. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.
localization.selected: 300%+ damage to 2 random enemies

localization.name: Heated March
localization.description:
This unit is immune to Poison status effects, and Stun effects.

Whenever this unit enters the battlefield, for 200TU, if this unit is burning, this unit cannot be defeated by damage and has 60% damage reduction from attacks.

At the end of each of this unit's turns, all ally Imposters on the battlefield are immediately defeated. This unit is considered to have defeated with attacks as many units as are defeated by this effect. This effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the targets from being defeated.

localization.name: Battle Tactics
localization.description:
Whenever an enemy enters the battlefield from reinforcements, they have a 50% chance to be granted the Burn status effect.

Each time a Burning unit gets the turn, this unit will be healed for 1% of its max HP.

Whenever another non-conjured Ally on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, all allies:
- are healed for 1% of max HP.
- are granted the Burn status effect.
- are Enraged.

localization.name: Immovable
localization.description: This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

localization.name: Sleep Immunity
localization.description: This unit is not affected by sleep effects.

localization.name: Fiery Hellball
localization.description:
200% damage to 1 enemy, plus 200% for each Charge stored on the user (max of 800% total damage). This attack ignores the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.

The user and target are both granted the Burn status effect. This will overwrite other status effects on those units. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with burn will also become burned.

Stuns for 50TU one other non-water, burning enemy per Charge stored on the user (max of 3 targets).
localization.selected: 200%+ damage, ignores skins & counter stances

localization.name: Cold Awakening
localization.description:
The user is granted a Charge, Sleep Ward, Poison Ward, Burn Shield and the Healing Burn status effect for 300TU. Then the user is Enraged, and will Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP.

Unlocked each time the user defeats a non-conjured enemy on the battlefield with an attack. This skill is locked again after each use.

Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges, and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards and Endure effects cannot stack. Burn Shields prevent the next non-burn status effect a unit would gain while Burning from applying. An Enraged unit's attack is increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn. Enrage will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on the user.

Then a random enemy has their Burn removed, and is granted Frostburn and infected with it. This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use. Usable 5 times per battle.

After the end of each turn, this infection will trigger to apply Frostburn to a random non-Frostburned unit on the infected unit's team. Infection ends after 3 triggers (even if they find no valid target) or once the infected enemy is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Infection is not a status effect and cannot be prevented or purified, but the effect spread by the infection may be. A unit cannot get a new infection until their existing one ends.

When a unit has Frostburn and they get the turn, they will lose the turn as if they were sleeping, then Frostburn is removed and that unit is granted the Burn status effect. Frostburn is not a status effect, but effects that remove negative status effects will also remove Frostburn. Frostburn will end if the affected unit is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Frostburn cannot apply to boss units, and cannot stack. Burn will overwrite other status effects. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with burn will also become burned.

localization.name: Étoile Queen
localization.description:
This unit cannot fall asleep or be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

This unit's attacks will not wake sleeping enemies, and heal this unit for 1% of total damage dealt.

Whenever another ally takes damage from an attack, this unit will have its TU reduced to 0. Then this effect cannot trigger again until 50TU advances. Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

If this unit has another ally on the battlefield, whenever this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit grants a random enemy the Deep Sleep status effect for 100TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. This is not a Skin passive skill.

Deep Sleep will overwrite other status effects, cannot be overwritten by Burn or Sleep status effects, and cannot be Purified.

localization.name: Étoile's Grace
localization.description:

If this unit would be defeated while it has a Power Charge, it instead survives with 1 HP and then cannot be defeated until its next turn. The Power Charge will be consumed when this effect is triggered.

Each time an ally (including this unit) gets the turn, this unit will become Purified (negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed) at the end of that turn.

Each time an enemy gets the turn, this unit will become Enraged at the end of that turn. An Enraged unit's attack is increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn. Enrage will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on this unit.

Power Charges can be consumed by certain skills to activate or enhance their effects. Power Charges will be removed if this unit leaves the battlefield. Power Charges cannot stack.

400% damage to 1 enemy, plus 200% for each charge stored by the user (max of 1000% total damage while 3 charges are stored by the user). This attack does not wake up sleeping enemies, and ignores skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

Then the target hit will become Weakened, and be granted a Rage Ward. This will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on that unit.

Rage Wards will prevent a unit from becoming Enraged once, then be removed. Rage Wards cannot stack. Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects.
localization.selected: 400%+ damage, weaken and grant rage ward

localization.name: Targets Acquired
localization.description:
Grants all non-Guardian enemies on the battlefield a Hunter's Mark.

Usable only if no enemies on the battlefield have a Hunter's Mark, and a valid target exists.

A unit with a Hunter's Mark has the next attack damage dealt to them increased to 1.25 times the normal amount, then the Hunter's Mark is removed. A Hunter's Mark is not a status effect. Hunter's Marks cannot stack, cannot apply to boss units, and cannot be purified. A Hunter's Mark is removed from a unit that is defeated or leaves the battlefield.
localization.selected: Grants all non-Guardians a Hunter's Mark

localization.name: Silver Onslaught
localization.description:
800% damage to 2 enemies. This attack ignores the Stealth status effect.

Unlocked each time an enemy unit with a Hunter's Mark is damaged by an attack other than Silver Onslaught. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.
localization.selected: 800% damage to 2 enemies, ignores Stealth

localization.name: Helsing's Hunt
localization.description:
The user is granted Sleep Immunity for 50TU, Stun Immunity for 50TU, Poison Immunity for 50TU, and is Fortified.

Then, for the next 3 turns the user gets while on the battlefield, whenever the user uses another active skill, the user will immediately get the next turn. These extra turns may be interrupted by other effects that influence the turn order (e.g. stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

Usable only if a non-conjured ally unit on the battlefield has been defeated or sacrificed by any source since the user entered the battlefield or if the user has defeated a non-conjured enemy with an attack. This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use. Usable 2 times per battle.

A Fortified unit has 50% damage reduction from attacks. This reduction cannot be ignored by attacks that do not specifically ignore Fortify. Fortify will be removed after reducing damage 3 times since applying, and will be reset if reapplied. This is not a status effect.
localization.selected: Grants immunities & Fortification

localization.name: Twilight Hunter
localization.description:
This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

This unit's attacks ignore damage reduction effects, and any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent targets from being defeated.

This unit will gain a Charge each time another ally gets the turn. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges, and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield.

When this unit enters battle, this unit grants all allies Sleep Immunity, Poison Immunity, and Stun Immunity until the end of their next turn while on the battlefield.

When this unit defeats an enemy with an attack, if they are:
- Dark or Storm, after the end of the turn, all allies on the battlefield, will be given the next turns by reducing their current TU. These TU reductions may trigger before or after other effects that adjust the turn order.
- Light or Earth, all allies on the battlefield will have the TU costs for all of their skills reduced by 20%. This will overwrite the effects of other Quicken skills.
- Water or Fire, all allies on the battlefield will be Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).
All of these defeat effects may trigger before or after other effects.

localization.name: Wooden Stake
localization.description:
If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

This unit has 35% damage reduction from attacks for 100TU. Afterwards this unit has 70% damage reduction instead.

After entering battle, for 100TU, each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will be Purified, and have its TU reduced to 0. This TU reduction may trigger before or after other effects that adjust the turn order.

At the end of the first turn this unit gets on the battlefield, this unit is granted Sleep Immunity for 50TU, Stun Immunity for 50TU, and Poison Immunity for 50TU.

localization.name: Shot in the Dark
localization.description:
300% damage to 1 enemy. 600% damage instead if any enemy on the battlefield has a current TU of 100TU or more. 900% damage instead if any enemy on the battlefield has a current TU of 200TU or more. This attack ignores skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect. This attack is considered a Time Strike type Active Skill.

When this attack hits a target and that target has a current TU of 100TU or less, the user is granted a Charge. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges.
localization.selected: 300%+ damage, may grant Charge

localization.name: Charged Clues
localization.description:
The user is granted a Charge. Heals all allies on the battlefield for 1% of the user's attack.

Then if any allies on the battlefield are burning, sleeping or poisoned, all allies are Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed), and the user is granted another Charge.

Unlocked each time the user uses Shot in the Dark, and is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.
localization.selected: Heals allies, grants Charge(s), may Purify

localization.name: Shocking Evidence
localization.description:
1 random enemy has their Active Skills disabled for 50TU, then all other enemies on the battlefield are stunned for 50TU. This effect triggers again for each Charge stored on the user (max of 4 times total if the user has stored 3 Charges.)

Usable only if there are at least 2 enemies on the battlefield and less than 2 enemies on the battlefield have their Active Skills disabled. Usable 5 times per battle.

When a unit's Active Skills are disabled and they get the turn, they will lose the turn as if they were sleeping. This effect cannot affect boss units, cannot be purified, and will end if the user is defeated.
localization.selected: Disables and Stuns Enemies

localization.name: Grand Detective
localization.description:
This unit cannot fall asleep or be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

This unit's attacks ignore damage reduction effects, and any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent targets from being defeated.

This unit has 20% damage reduction from attacks for each Charge stored on this unit (max of 60% while 3 Charges are stored on this unit).

Whenever this unit gains a Charge from one of its own active skills, 1 random enemy's Active Skills are disabled for 50TU. This effect cannot trigger from a Charge gained while this unit already has 3 Charges stored.

localization.name: Londinium's Finest
localization.description:
This unit cannot be poisoned for 100TU.

If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will be Purified.

After the end of each other ally's turn, this unit will have its TU reduced to 0. This TU reduction may trigger before or after other effects that adjust the turn order. Then this effect cannot trigger again until 50TU advances.

When this unit takes damage from an attack, they will immediately get the next turn, this cannot trigger again until TU advances. This is a skin effect. This unit cannot become a Guardian or Stun Absorber.

localization.name: Final Deduction
localization.description:
700% damage to 2 enemies. 850% damage instead if the user has survived 100TU or more on the battlefield. 1000% damage instead if the user has survived 200TU or more on the battlefield.

Usable only if the user has stored 3 Charges. Consumes all Charges on the user. This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use.
